_note: REQ-L10N-012: English race commentary. Same phrase kinds, variant ids and placeholders as commentary-ja.json (engine test CommentaryLocaleTests checks every key). {place} is spoken as an ordinal (3rd); horse and skill names come from the English tables, katakana names romanized. Animal welfare: the whip is a cue, never described as hurting the horse.
